text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Wednesday:
- France has made the import of Swiss cows more difficult only a few days after Italy's decision to ban imports.
- Alusuisse Lonza appointed Canadian Sergio Marchionne, its former finance director, as new CEO.
- Geneva-based pharmaceuticals group Ares-Serono achieved sales of $562 million in the first nine months of 1996, 11.9 percent more than in the same period last year.
- Migros grocery chain decided to permanently close down operations in Austria and to sell its "Familia" shops to Spar AG.
- Eight out of pregnant women in Geneva give birth prematurely, according to a cantonal medical study.
